agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - SEPTEMBER 27, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated September 27, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated September 27, 2012 in the total amount of $5,231,949.12.
8.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of September 13, 2012. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting minutes of September 13, 2012.
9.
Miscellaneous
A.
Biennial notice to the City Council regarding review of City/Successor Agency/Public Financing Authority and Oversight Board Conflict of Interest Codes. (COUNCIL)
receive and file this report.
End of Consent Calendar
10.
Public Hearings
A.
A request by Irvine University, 10900 183rd Street, Suite 330, Cerritos, California, 90703 on behalf of the property owner, Cerritos Office Center V, LLC, for approval of a Conditional Use Permit for an educational institution at 17871 Park Plaza Drive, Suite 125, Cerritos, California, 90703. The subject property is zoned Development Area Two (ADP-2) (APN 7030-011-009). (COUNCIL)
Conditional Use Permit 2012-4*
*Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt.
approve Conditional Use Permit 2012-4, making the findings set forth in Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2012-31.
11.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration and approval of an agreement with the Conservation Corps of Long Beach for employing "at risk" youth to perform landscape maintenance services at various City parks and facilities. (COUNCIL)
1. Approve and agreement with the Conservation Corps of Long Beach for employing "at risk" youth to perform landscape maintenance services at various City parks and facilities; and
2. Authorize the Public Works Director to execute the agreement.
B.
Consideration and award of Bid No. 1143-13, Printing of the 2013 Cerritos Community Calendar. (COUNCIL)
award Bid No. 1143-13 to Anderson Printing for the printing of the 2013 Cerritos Community Calendar in the amount of $25,420.31.
C.
Consideration and award of Bid No. 1149-13, Printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2012-2013 Second Seasonal Calendar. (COUNCIL)
award Bid No. 1149-13 to Advantage Mailing, Inc. for the printing of the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts 2012-2013 Second Seasonal Calendar in the amount of $27,076.84.
12.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor’s Office for signature.
13.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
14.
Adjournment
